title: Jade Cat Ascension
subtitle: Cat Life Simulator · 10-year units · 500-year cap
description: A jade pendant sends a house cat into a cultivation world. Draw three talents, choose one, and let random events, cultivation, belly, morality, age and cumulative lifespan decide your ending.

catalog.eyebrow: A third glimmer has woken up
catalog.cardDescription: Cat life restart: draw three talents, choose one, then meet random cultivation events. Age, attributes and choices decide whether you ascend, guard the mountain, or return to a sunny balcony.
catalog.actionSummary: Draw talents · Random events · Attribute endings

milestones.title: Spirit energy enters the body
milestones.text: Your meridians start absorbing spirit energy on their own.

milestones.title: Too fat to fly
milestones.text: You tried wind-riding. The wind said you're too heavy.

milestones.title: Dark energy grows
milestones.text: A dark vein surfaces on your jade pendant.

events.title: The Crane's Choice
events.event: You are an ordinary orange tabby, curled on a sixth-floor balcony. A crane dives from the clouds and lands in front of you. It says you carry a faint trace of spirit root. The crane places a glowing jade pendant by your paw: 'Hold it, and it will take you where you need to go.'

choices.result: The pendant warms on your tongue. The balcony light pulls back like water, and the crane nods: this cat is accepted.
You sniff twice. The pendant smells like grass and morning dew, and the crane waits patiently.
You bury your head in your paws. The crane leaves the pendant nearby and waits for you to change your mind.

events.title: The Pendant Lifts You
events.event: The pendant grows warm in your mouth. The light intensifies — the balcony railing is gone, the AC unit is gone. You're standing on a cloud, the crane leading the way to a place called 'Jade Sect.'

choices.result: You follow the crane onto the cloud road. The Jade Sect gate brightens at the far end of the sky.
You look down and see mountains stacked like blue roof tiles. The pendant keeps you steady.
You try to open your mouth, but the pendant stays warm against your tongue. The crane glances back.

events.title: Jade Sect Takes You In
events.event: The crane sets you down at the Jade Sect gate. A white-bearded elder studies you and says: 'This cat has spirit root. Start as an outer disciple.' He gives you a wooden tag with your name and a number.

choices.result: You press your paw on the Sword Yard tag. A distant rack rings, and the elder calls you an auxiliary cat.
Warm air wraps your whiskers with sweet, bitter, and burnt smells. A senior leaves you a window cushion.

choices.text: Sneak to the spirit orchard first
choices.result: You slip into the spirit orchard without a sound. Only the branches move; two spirit fruits reach your paws.

events.title: Morning drill
events.event: First day as a disciple. Senior brothers line up to practice. You line up at the end — the wooden tag still hangs from your neck.

choices.hint: Even if the moves look wrong
choices.result: You finish the last row of movements. Wind begins to circle your paw tips, even if your tail lags.

choices.text: Hide in the back and sleep
choices.result: You sleep at the back and dream of a perfect sword form. The seniors finish just as you wake.
You copy the rhythm of a senior's tail and suddenly understand half a movement technique.

events.title: Library encounter
events.event: You sneak into the archive and find an unnamed manual in the far corner. The cover has a cat on it.

choices.hint: The cover has a cat on it
choices.result: The pages turn themselves to a cat-paw diagram. The lines breathe, and you forget the time.
You carry the book out past a yawning guard. It grows faintly warm in your mouth.
You bury yourself in books while dust falls through the light. Someone reads a cat technique in your dream.

events.title: Kitchen duty
events.event: It's your turn to help cook. The crane says the spirit rice should be softer than yesterday.

choices.result: The spirit rice turns soft, and the crane claps its wings. The spoonful left for you smells better than usual.
You taste three times in secret and decide the seasoning is right. Steam curls your whiskers.
A burnt smell rises from the pot. The crane says nothing, but looks at the pot one more time.

events.title: Cloud nap
events.event: You slept on the cloud terrace all afternoon. When you woke, someone had tucked a thin spirit-mist blanket over you.

choices.result: The spirit mist rises and falls with your breathing. When you wake, sunlight has moved to your belly.

choices.hint: Cloud shapes look like sword moves
choices.result: Half asleep, you see cloud movement become a slow sword form. Your tail learns it first.

events.title: Chasing a butterfly
events.event: A glowing butterfly flies past. You chased it across three mountain peaks.

choices.result: You catch the glowing butterfly. It scatters into warm light between your paws.
You stop after three mountain ridges and turn to the cloud sea. The butterfly circles once, like a message.

events.title: Accidental pill
events.event: You accidentally ate an unfinished pill. Your stomach rumbled for a whole hour.

choices.result: You keep your tail stiff and silent while spirit energy gurgles in your belly. A senior assumes you are meditating.
The elder touches your belly and gives you warm water. The alchemy-room smoke retreats through the window.

events.title: Pill festival
events.event: The sect holds an elixir fair. You crouch in the corner and sniff them one by one.

choices.result: You sniff along the stalls and memorize seventeen medicine scents. The vendors start watching this professional cat.

choices.hint: You think you can do it too
choices.result: You sit on the contest mat and the crowd gasps. The first elixir obeys you better than expected.
You slip behind the stall with a tiny pill. It tastes sweet like dried fish.

events.title: Cultivating in the rain
events.event: It rains. Other cats hide; you stand in it and cultivate. There's spirit energy in the rain.

choices.result: Rain runs down your fur in a thin line while spirit energy hums beneath your skin. The mountain stays with you.
You listen under the eaves until your breathing matches the rain. A senior notices and leaves you alone.

events.title: Crane's gift
events.event: A crane drops a spirit fish in front of you. It looks deliberate.

choices.result: The spirit fish glows faintly in your mouth. The crane flaps its wings, satisfied.
You push the fish back. The crane takes one bite and its eyes curve warmly.

events.title: Meditation
events.event: You sit in the spirit array. After an hour you open your eyes and find thin ice on your whiskers.

choices.result: Ice climbs your whiskers while the array's light follows your spine. Your breath becomes slower.
You open your eyes as the array stops. Even an insect on your nose does not move.

events.title: Cave cleaning
events.event: It's your turn to clean the cave. You swept all the dust to your senior brother's door.

choices.result: The cave becomes spotless. The senior sleeping inside wakes and thinks he has changed caves.
The dust cloud lands exactly at the senior's door and slips inside. You hear a muffled cough.

events.title: Night watch
events.event: It's your turn to keep watch. The moonlight is bright and you see three night spirit beasts you've never seen before.

choices.result: Stars connect into a thin line. At the ninth star, you understand a little of the sky's direction.
Night beasts pass without disturbing each other, and you memorize their steps.
You circle the cliff and leave your scent on the key stones. A patrolling senior nods to you.

events.title: Mouse swordsman
events.event: You're on an errand for the sect when a rogue mouse-swordsman blocks the mountain path. His tail is tied in a nervous knot.

choices.result: Cat sword and mouse sword meet. Grass breaks, and the mouse swordsman steps back with real attention.
The mouse swordsman freezes, eats the dried fish, and his tangled tail loosens. He promises to yield the road next time.
You roll onto your back. The mouse swordsman circles, then suspiciously pokes your paw pad with his sword tip.

events.title: Secret realm opens
events.event: A spinning gate of light appears in the mountain wall.

choices.result: You enter the light gate and the stone steps rotate. The mountain wind is completely shut outside.
You call the other cats and enter tail to tail. The realm mist hesitates before closing.
You moonbathe outside the gate and hear a distant bell. The light slowly steadies.

events.title: The fruit tempts
events.event: The only ten-thousand-year spirit fruit is ripe, and the orchard crane is away.

choices.result: The spirit fruit dissolves and warm energy reaches your claws. Leaves applaud lightly.

choices.text: Eat it all with fish paste
choices.result: You eat the whole fruit with fish paste and your belly rounds out. Cultivation should not be hungry.
You give most of the fruit to an injured senior and keep one slice. Their wound visibly closes.

events.title: A test of heart
events.event: Your senior collapsed by the stone steps, a glowing treasure box beside them.

choices.result: The senior is surprisingly light on your back while the box swings at your side. You both head for the gate.
The box lock clicks under your paw. The mountain path is too quiet, except for your heartbeat.
The signal charm bursts into green light. The senior finally relaxes against the tree root.

events.title: Cliff-side ginseng
events.event: You spot a nine-leaf spirit ginseng on the cliff edge. The wind is strong.

choices.result: You climb down the cliff with wind threading through your paw pads. The nine-leaf herb glows before you.
After half an hour, the wind finally removes one leaf. The herb itself does not move, as if testing you.

events.title: Dream transmission
events.event: You meet a white-haired immortal in a dream. He hands you a key.

choices.result: The key is still warm in your paw. A small door brightens at the edge of the dream.
The white-haired immortal laughs. He says your question is worth more than the key.

events.title: Merchant cat
events.event: A merchant cat appears at the gate, selling strange things.

choices.text: Buy a full vial of clarity pills
choices.result: You swallow the vial in three doses. Ears, whiskers, and tail tip all glow. The merchant cat counts five dried fish and hands you the vial cap: worth it.
The safety charm warms like a sunlit stone. The merchant cat bows to you.
You walk away with your fish pouch still full. Behind you, the merchant whispers that this cat is calm.

events.title: The dragon's invitation
events.event: A silver dragon circles above the castle and looks down at you. It says it wants to invite you to dinner.

choices.result: The dragon claw lifts you to a cloud table where food scent lowers the sky. The silver dragon waits.
You bow like a cat and return to the mountain path. The dragon's tail waves goodbye.

events.title: Early tribulation
events.event: Heavenly thunder falls, three hundred years ahead of schedule.

choices.result: Lightning bursts across your fur, but your paws stay locked to the ground. Only burnt smell remains.
You shield the other cats and lightning scatters around your back. Their eyes fill with your raised fur.
The dark vein in your jade lights up and redirects lightning to a rock. Somewhere, a cat inhales.

events.title: Ancient cat ruins
events.event: You find a cat statue in an abandoned immortal palace. Its eyes are moving.

choices.result: The stone cat's eyes turn toward you and the platform trembles. Dust falls like an old welcome.
You find a cat-paw bronze shard with faint light. The ruin seems to want to be read.

events.title: Time fruit
events.event: You eat a time fruit. It first adds a hundred years to your lifespan, then makes you stand in place for a hundred years that feel like one second.

choices.result: Before the sweetness fades, vines green and yellow. The fruit's hundred borrowed years exactly hold the passing time.
The other cats freeze as they bite and their shadows lengthen. You share the hundred years without being pushed to the end.

events.title: The fox asks
events.event: A nine-tailed spirit fox asks you to teach it cat hunting techniques. You taught it 'pretend not to care'.

choices.result: You demonstrate how to pretend not to care. The fox learns instantly and its tails line up.
The fox draws half a rune and light scatters into plum blossoms. It says you are more polite than most cats.

events.title: The immortal cat's last words
events.event: Deep in a cave you find a stone tablet. The last cat who ascended left one sentence: 'Remember to eat enough.'

choices.result: You bow three times and the paw prints on the tablet glow. The cave wind becomes warm.
You reread those words until your stomach rumbles. The tablet shakes slightly, as if laughing.

events.title: Heaven's gift
events.event: A golden light falls from the sky and lands on you. You burp.

choices.result: Golden light passes from your head to your tail, and you hiccup. The cloud opening aligns exactly with you.
You sidestep. The light lands on a stone and brightens the moss while the crane circles above.

events.title: The ten-thousand-cat assembly
events.event: Every cat who ever ascended is watching you from the cloud sea. One of them winks.

choices.result: You lower your front paws and ten thousand cat spirits bow at once. The cloud world falls silent.

choices.text: Wink back at the winking cat
choices.result: The winking cat winks again and the cloud sea sways. You seem to share an understanding.

events.title: The samsara pond
events.event: You see your past life at the reincarnation pond: a lazy house cat lying in the best patch of sunlight.

choices.text: Look at your past life longer
choices.result: The lazy cat in the water rolls over and sunlight moves with it. You remember how warm home was.
You turn from the water and stone steps appear in the mist. The pond grows quiet.

endings.title: Immortal King of Ten Thousand Cats
endings.description: Mahayana is only the threshold. The closer your cultivation is to 100, the more likely the cloud sea opens. First decree: one extra midnight meal every day.

endings.title: Free and Wicked Cat Immortal
endings.description: You took shortcuts and tricks through the trial. The sect posted a notice: valuable boxes should be fitted with cat locks.

endings.title: The Chubby Guardian Cat
endings.description: Your belly took the last ray of lightning. Daily duty: guarding the spirit orchard and tasting the harvest.

endings.title: Back to the Sunny Balcony
endings.description: You never became an immortal, but you remember the best patch of sunlight. The crane says you can return any time. You say: after a nap.

endings.title: The Wandering Cat
endings.description: Your cat life ends without ascension and without a balcony. You roam freely, just strong enough to leap between rooftops.
